1: # Implementation Checklist: HashLine Edit Plugin

13: - [x] 2.2 Build `DICT` lookup table with 256 entries (nibble pairs)

19: - [x] 2.8 Implement `validateLineRef(ref, fileLines)` to check hash matches

29: ## 4. Prefix Stripping Module (hashline-strip.ts)

31: - [x] 4.1 Implement `stripNewLinePrefixes(lines)` function
32: - [x] 4.2 Add detection logic for `LINE#HASH:` pattern (regex: `/^\d+#[A-Z]{2}:/`)
33: - [x] 4.3 Implement >50% threshold heuristic (only strip if majority match)

37: ## 5. System Prompt Module (hashline-prompt.ts)

45: - [x] 5.7 Add recovery rules section (tag mismatch retry, no-op handling)

48: ## 6. Edit Application Engine (hashline-apply.ts)
49: 
50: - [x] 6.1 Define `EditOperation` TypeScript interface

55: - [x] 6.6 Implement `applyAppend(edit, lines)` for after-line and EOF append
56: - [x] 6.7 Implement `applyPrepend(edit, lines)` for before-line and BOF prepend
57: - [x] 6.8 Implement `deduplicateEdits(edits)` using Set with serialized keys
58: - [x] 6.9 Implement `detectNoOp(edit, oldContent, newContent)` comparison
59: - [x] 6.10 Create `applyHashlineEdits(path, edits)` main orchestrator function

61: ## 7. Plugin Entry Point — hashline_read Tool
62: 
63: - [x] 7.1 Implement `hashline_read` tool schema with `filePath`, `offset`, `limit` parameters
64: - [x] 7.2 Add binary file detection (check for null bytes in first 8KB)
65: - [x] 7.3 Implement file reading with Bun.file().text()

72: ## 8. Plugin Entry Point — hashline_edit Tool

74: - [x] 8.1 Implement `hashline_edit` tool schema with `path`, `edits`, `delete`, `move` parameters

84: ## 9. Plugin Entry Point — hashline_grep Tool

86: - [x] 9.1 Implement `hashline_grep` tool schema with `pattern`, `path`, `include`, `context` parameters
87: - [x] 9.2 Implement ripgrep execution via `Bun.$` shell command

95: ## 10. Plugin Registration & Hook
96: 
97: - [x] 10.1 Create main plugin export function at `.opencode/plugins/hashline-edit.ts`

120: - [x] 11.13 Test `validateLineRef`: returns true for matching hash
121: - [x] 11.14 Test `validateLineRef`: returns false for mismatched hash
122: - [x] 11.15 Test `validateLineRef`: returns false for out of range line

124: ## 12. Unit Tests — Edit Engine

143: ## 13. Unit Tests — Strip Module
